findings.evidence: Java and Python use com.amazon.mShop.android.shopping / UID10129, self org.droidloom.qa.amazon.r1 and pocket4-owned-amazon-qa-v1. Java additionally obtains actual target ApplicationInfo.uid and requires exact UID; self instrumentation requires both context packages equal SELF. Escaped package regexes are full-match and retain the old resource/activity suffix classes.

Only usb c cable is admitted for set_text. The original successful-inspection nonce/hash/age, current tree/window, refreshed exact resource/class/capability and focused-window gates remain unchanged. The performed SET_TEXT bundle uses the same fixed query, then the actual target text must equal it; Python requires requested and observed value hashes equal the same query.

parse_completed retains explicit integer/range/self_uid equality and adds prior target/helper UIDs to the exclusion tuple. This narrows admission and does not substitute a static helper UID for actual installed identity.

qa_adapter.execute unconditionally raises DEDICATED_AMAZON_HELD_FLOW_ADMISSION_REQUIRED. Existing Session is not accepted as a reviewed Amazon business Flow. No runtime request or UI capability is granted by this source review.
A few unchanged diagnostic strings contain BILI; predicates use the new exact PACKAGE/UID. These labels do not change authorization. No cosmetic source revision is requested during this freeze.

limits: Source-only narrow review; no Java compilation, Android install, instrumentation, device, UI or commercial raw tree read.
No rerun of the authors 16 controls and no assertion that a live Amazon EditText/resource/Flow is supported.
No full builder/request/Session/old framework re-review and no overall App production qualification.
